after.description: The MOVA V50 Ultra Complete is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 24,000 Pa suction, a dual rotary mop spinning at 260 RPM and a JetSpray washboard with 20 water nozzles. StepMaster retractable legs are claimed to cross obstacles up to 6 cm, including a two-layer threshold and a 4.2 cm vertical step; these are obstacle-crossing claims, not robot dimensions. The dock is described with automatic hot-water tank refill, dual cleaning-solution compartments of 400 ml general solution and 200 ml pet odor eliminator, dust-box and dust-bag drying, and 60 C hot-air mop drying for one hour. A 3.2 L dust bag is claimed to support up to 100 days between manual emptying. The page states a 6,400 mAh battery but publishes no runtime, robot dimensions, mass, robot water-tank capacity, cleaning width, charging time, IP rating, payload or initial release year. The listed price is 799 USD and both embedded offers are marked out of stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Battery capacity is not converted into runtime; obstacle height and dock capacities are not robot dimensions, payload or cleaning width.

after.description: The MOVA P50 Pro Ultra is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 19,000 Pa suction, dual rotary mops and a 3.2 L dock dust bag. Published robot dimensions are 350 x 350 x 103.8 mm and robot mass is 4 kg; the dock measures 420 x 458 x 470 mm and weighs 9 kg. The dock is specified with 4 L clean and 3.5 L used-water tanks, 75 C mop washing and 45 C air drying, while the robot dust box is 300 ml. A 5,200 mAh battery, 22 mm obstacle-crossing height, extendable side brush and mop, RGB camera dirt detection and 32 adjustable water levels are described. MOVA claims up to 75 days between dust emptying. The listed price is 449 USD; one embedded variant is in stock and one is out of stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Runtime, robot water-tank capacity, cleaning width, charging time, IP rating, payload and initial release year are not published. Dock dimensions, dock tanks, threshold height and dust-box volume are separate from robot dimensions, payload and cleaning width.

after.handType: None; autonomous vacuum and mop robot
after.description: The MOVA Z60 Ultra Roller Complete is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 28,000 Pa suction and 4,100 Pa downward mop pressure. Its roller mop is published as 10.08 in wide and can extend by 1.61 in; this is mop width and extension, not a whole-machine cleaning-pass or hourly coverage rating. HydroForce sprays fresh water and removes dirty water in real time, while AutoShield retracts the mop and deploys moisture shields on detected carpets. StepMaster 2.0 retractable legs are claimed to cross obstacles up to 3.15 in (8 cm), with a single crossable obstacle up to 1.89 in. A 96 mm body height is published; FlexScope retracts the navigation sensor for low-clearance access. Binocular AI is claimed to identify more than 200 obstacle types. The dock advertises 80 C mop washing, dual cleaning-solution compartments, auto refill and emptying, and a 3.2 L dust bag supporting up to 100 days between manual emptying. The listed price is 1,199 USD and the embedded offer is in stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Robot mass, full dimensions, battery capacity, runtime, charging time, IP rating, payload and initial release year are not published; the 96 mm height is not a complete dimensional envelope.

after.description: The MOVA E40 Ultra is a vacuum and mop robot advertised with 19,000 Pa suction, a 5,200 mAh battery and an 80 ml built-in mopping water tank. MOVA claims up to 260 minutes of quiet vacuuming and up to 220 m2 on one charge in its in-house test. The mop raises by 10.5 mm, and the page states a 22 mm height difference before and after mop lifting; that is not an obstacle-crossing or threshold rating. The mop extends up to 4 cm for edge cleaning. A 3.2 L dust bag is claimed to support up to 75 days of maintenance-free cleaning. Ultrasonic carpet detection, suction boost, three mopping levels and hot-air mop drying are described. The listed price is 449 USD and the embedded offer is in stock at the November 4, 2026 check. Robot dimensions, mass, cleaning width, charging time, IP rating, payload and initial release year are not published. Runtime and area are manufacturer Quiet-mode test claims with stated assumptions, not guaranteed coverage.

limitations: Nine exact MOVA US product pages support the selected reviews; one exact path returned 404 and one first request returned 429 before a successful retry.
Dock clean/used-water tanks are not recorded as robot water-tank capacity; threshold and body-height claims are not robot dimensions.
The Z60 roller-mop width and extension are not a whole-machine cleaning-pass or hourly coverage rating.
The E40 22 mm figure is a height difference before and after mop lifting, not an obstacle-crossing or threshold rating.
Battery capacities are not converted into runtime; the E40 260-minute claim retains its Quiet Mode and 220 m2 in-house test conditions.
V50 offers are listed but marked out of stock; the listed price is not proof of availability.
